column1: # direct_callable.tsv — corpus for the metamorphic "direct vs callable" lane.
# Invariant (Issue #10465, root-cause class #3 of #10452): a public function or
# constructor must produce the SAME result value, result type, and exception
# class no matter how it is invoked:
# These are the exact call shapes behind the #10187 / #10250 divergence family
# (compiler intercept vs Base / first-class / HOF dispatch).
# The harness (scripts/metamorphic_equivalence.sh) runs each lane, normalizes
# lane-induced noise (source line/col, stacktrace frames), and compares every
# non-reference lane against the FIRST lane listed (the reference). A divergence
# fails the gate unless it is registered in
# docs/vm/EQUIVALENCE_KNOWN_DIVERGENCES.tsv with a linked Issue (two-sided: a
# registered divergence that later AGREES also fails, forcing the row's removal).
#   name       unique case id (also the allowlist key)
#   preamble   Julia setup statements (";"-separated); "-" for none
#   call       function / constructor expression (bare name for the base lane)
#   lanes      comma list from {direct,base,bind,hof}; first = reference
# All values are printed as `println(v)` + `println(typeof(v))` and compared.
